name: Central Metal Fabricators, Inc.
old_description: Since 1980, Central Metal Fabricators, Inc. has provided innovative design, fabrication, and assembly services to a diverse range of industries. We stock over 800 different parts, and have the documentation to manufacture thousands more.
about:
Central Metal Fabricators, Inc. (CMF) was founded in 1980 in Farmingdale, New Jersey. The company began as a welding and repair shop and has since grown into a designer and fabricator of precision components and assemblies.

CMF operates a 35,000-square-foot manufacturing facility staffed by approximately 25 skilled employees. Its capabilities span design, engineering, rapid prototyping, reverse engineering, and full-scale fabrication. Processes include laser cutting, CNC milling, turning, punching, and bending; manual and CNC machining; MIG and TIG welding; mechanical and electrical assembly; wiring harness manufacturing for high- and low-voltage applications; and industrial sewing for strap assemblies. The company stocks over 800 parts and maintains documentation for thousands more.

The company serves commercial, industrial, military, medical, pharmaceutical, research, and food-preparation industries. Approximately 95 percent of its work supports the United States Armed Forces, including installations such as Aberdeen Proving Ground, Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst, NAVAIR, Naval Surface Warfare Center, Picatinny Arsenal, Tobyhanna Army Depot, and others. The remaining balance serves commercial clients.

CMF highlights a record of no financial defaults, no litigation, no lost-time injuries, and no adverse actions from the EPA, OSHA, or NJDEP. It attributes its longevity to first-class personnel, superior capabilities, and traditional business values.
